title: Health Shield Comprehensive Policy
content:
# Health Shield Comprehensive Policy Document

## 1. Overview
The Health Shield Comprehensive Health Insurance plan is designed to provide coverage for individuals and families (up to 4 members). It covers hospitalization, day-care procedures, and pre/post-hospitalization expenses.

## 2. Eligibility
- Primary Applicant Age: 18 to 65 years.
- Dependent Children: 91 days to 25 years.
- Renewability: Lifetime renewability is guaranteed.

## 3. Waiting Periods
- **Initial Waiting Period:** 30 days from policy inception (except for accidental injuries).
- **Specific Illnesses:** 24 months waiting period for conditions like Cataract, Hernia, and Joint Replacements.
- **Pre-Existing Diseases (pre-existing condition):** 36 months waiting period for any pre-existing conditions declared at the time of policy purchase.

## 4. Coverage Details
- **In-Patient Hospitalization:** Up to 100% of the sum insured for room rent, ICU, doctor fees, and medicines.
- **Pre & Post Hospitalization:** 30 days before admission and 60 days after discharge.
- **day-care procedure Procedures:** Covers all day-care treatments where less than 24 hours of hospitalization is required.

## 5. Exclusions
- Dental treatment (unless requiring hospitalization due to an accident).
- Cosmetic surgery or aesthetic treatments.
- Self-inflicted injuries.
- Unproven or experimental treatments.

## 6. no-claim bonus (no-claim bonus)
For every claim-free year, the sum insured increases by 10%, up to a maximum of 50%. If a claim is made, the accrued no-claim bonus reduces by 10% in the following year, but the base sum insured remains intact.

## 7. Claim Process
In case of a planned hospitalization, the third-party administrator must be informed 48 hours in advance. For emergency admissions, intimation must be given within 24 hours of admission.
